description: This file defines the EmbeddedFiles class, representing a collection of embedded files within a document object model, including methods for managing and serializing embedded file objects.

classes.name: EmbeddedFiles
classes.description: Represents a collection of embedded files within a document, allowing addition, retrieval, and serialization of embedded file objects.

classes.name: EmbeddedFiles.EmbeddedFilesValues
classes.description: Holds internal nullable property values for the EmbeddedFiles collection.

methods.name: this[int index]
methods.description: Indexer to get an embedded file at a specific index, ensuring it is of type EmbeddedFile.

methods.name: Add(string name, string path)
methods.description: Creates and adds a new EmbeddedFile to the collection with the specified name and path.

methods.name: Serialize(Serializer serializer)
methods.description: Serializes all embedded files in the collection using the provided serializer.

methods.name: Meta
methods.description: Returns meta-information about the EmbeddedFiles class for internal reflection.

methods.name: Values
methods.description: Returns the internal values object for the EmbeddedFiles instance.
